parsed.summary: The PR resolves the issue of TypeError when using Q() & Exists() by adding __rand__, __ror__, __and__, and __or__ methods to the Exists class. It also updates the Q class to handle Exists objects.

issues.description: The PR introduces new methods to the Exists class and updates the Q class, which may not align with the project's conventions for handling such operations.
